$Comment: Hytale's anniversary achievement: be on the server on January 13th.
Occurrence ties it to the Hytale_Anniversary calendar event, so the library keeps one copy a year,
named hytale_anniversary_<year>. A copy counts only on its own year's day and afterwards stays a
feat for whoever earned it. CALENDAR_ATTENDED fires once per player for each year's run, the first
time they are in the world that day, so being here is all it takes. The criterion's TextKey words
the step, since the shared sentence names the event by its raw id.
Text needs no keys: the title and description every copy shares come from the id, as
achievement.hytale_anniversary.title and .desc, and TextArgs puts the copy's year in the title. A
year whose own line ships, achievement.hytale_anniversary_<year>.title, is named by that line
instead: Hytale's First Anniversary for the first.
Listing files it under Seasons, in the Hytale_Anniversary subcategory, which is where the
anniversary's Almanac page finds it. It carries no season_keepsake tag and its page names no
Keepsake, so the Seasons of Orbis ladder never counts it.
Every year's copy pays its points and the title Hytale_Anniversary_Ever_Present through the Title
reward kind, and nothing else. The title is the same every year, so a player who earns a later
year's copy already holds it and keeps it; the grant changes nothing.
